Package com.example.androidexample

Class Transaction

java.lang.Object
com.example.androidexample.Transaction
public class Transaction extends Object
Represents a financial transaction within the application.

Each transaction has an ID, a name/description, an amount, associated group and bill IDs, and a date indicating when the transaction occurred.
